title: Cayley Pro source staging packet with selected JP2 masters
summary: Large ChatGPT Pro source-staging folder for future Arthur Cayley repair work. It selects one JP2 master source per Cayley volume where possible, splits oversized masters into sub-500 MB chunks, includes generated witness-image packs and unitized indexes for localization, and carries audit notes warning that existing Cayley TeX/PDF is salvage/control material rather than source authority.
source_policy: Use selected JP2 master ZIPs/chunks in 01_best_source_masters as source authority.
Derivative PDFs are not authority when a JP2 master exists; the local source verdict found some derivative PDFs to be only about 100-166 dpi.
Generated witness-image packs are localization/render witnesses only and do not override JP2 source masters.
Existing Cayley TeX/PDF must be treated as salvage/control material until exact page ranges are re-promoted by page-by-page glyph/source audit.
upload_strategy: Upload 00_START_HERE_CAYLEY_PRO_SOURCE_STAGING_20260629.md, SOURCE_SELECTION_MANIFEST.csv, UPLOAD_ORDER.csv, and EXCLUDED_SOURCE_CANDIDATES.csv first.
Upload 02_generated_witness_images only when repair/localization should reuse existing witness PNGs.
Upload 03_indices_and_audits so web/pro sessions see source-authority caveats.
selected_sources_summary: Vols. 03, 04, 11, 13 high-resolution Cayley/Rich JP2 masters split into chunks
excluded_source_policy: Several Sylv/Sylvester-family or derivative-PDF candidates are deliberately excluded from the upload set pending identity verification or because a better JP2 source exists.
public_disposition: Do not present as a new Cayley reader version.
Do not promote any Cayley range as source-faithful from this packet alone.
Use as a reproducible source/handoff kit for future repair sessions.
Keep existing public Cayley caveat: no range is currently promoted as source-faithful unless a future page-by-page glyph/source audit explicitly re-promotes that exact range.
